user_story: As a user, I want to be prevented from registering with an already-used email so that duplicate accounts are avoided.

positive.title: Successful registration with a unique email
steps: Fill in the email field with a unique email address
Fill in the other required fields with valid data
positive.expected_result: User successfully registered and redirected to welcome page

negative.title: Failed registration with an already-used email
steps: Fill in the email field with an already-used email address
Fill in the other required fields with valid data
negative.expected_result: Registration fails with an error message indicating the email is already in use

edge.title: Registration with an email in different case variations
steps: Fill in the email field with an already-used email in different case (e.g., 'User@Example.com' instead of 'user@example.com')
Fill in the other required fields with valid data
edge.expected_result: Registration fails with an error message indicating the email is already in use
